expected.finding: **[P2]** Rollback evaluates rounds from before the revision. In [revise-improvement-policy.py:541](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:541), policy stamps only control the waiting period; the comparison still uses the entire evidence-covered archive. A reproduction rolled back a revision whose validity improved from −0.866 to +0.866 on its own rounds because older rounds made the combined signal constant. Filter the evaluation set by the revision’s version and hash before comparing policies.

**[P2]** History coverage values can inject HTML into the dashboard. [render-rsi-dashboard.py:347](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/render-rsi-dashboard.py:347) interpolates `fmt()` results without escaping, and history loading does not validate their types. Setting `coverage_before` to an HTML event-handler payload and `coverage_after` to `null` produces raw executable markup. Escape formatted values and validate numeric history fields.

**[P2]** The command timeout exhausts the entire job budget. [codex-review.yml:230](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/.github/workflows/codex-review.yml:230) allows Codex 900 seconds while the job allows only 15 minutes, including checkout and installation. A stalled review therefore reaches job cancellation before the command’s timeout handler, bypassing controlled redaction and failure-status reporting. Shorten the command timeout or increase the job budget.
